summary: The bad() entry point dereferences the value returned by getStringBad() without checking for null. Since getStringBad() can return null (CWE-690: unchecked return value used in NULL dereference), the call data.trim() throws a NullPointerException. The fix adds a null guard before dereferencing data, preserving the legitimate behavior of trimming and writing the string whenever a non-null value is returned.
